changelog: Aura AI v2.1.7 — Fix Voice Call 'Conversation Already Exists' Handshake & Stream Sync
Voice Call Handshake Fix: Gracefully adopt conversations already registered on the hub language server instead of failing with ServerError
Persistent Stream Title Sync: Mark voice-initiated conversations with title 'Voice chat' so live agent speech and tool actions stream seamlessly
Robust Hub Header Framing: Ensure framed CSRF token fallback header is sent on WebSocket handshakes to prevent connection rejections
